title: Power Rankings: No dethroning Dallas, but West elite keeping pace
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 18
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Yet another streak to track: Mavs are 11-0 in the second game of back-to-backs, with five to go. No team has ever finished a season losing fewer than two such games.
rankings.summaryText: Yet another streak to track: Mavs are 11-0 in the second game of back-to-backs, with five to go. No team has ever finished a season losing fewer than two such games.

rankings.summaryHtml: Still not quite sure how they scored just 94 points to lose in Philly, even without Marion, but Suns continue to look more like themselves again at 7-1 with Nash back.
rankings.summaryText: Still not quite sure how they scored just 94 points to lose in Philly, even without Marion, but Suns continue to look more like themselves again at 7-1 with Nash back.

rankings.summaryHtml: It's definitely starting too late to erase Dallas' nine-game division lead, but an eight-game winning streak suggests Spurs' annual second-half push is finally in gear.

rankings.summaryHtml: These Jazz have suddenly won four straight roadies, all by double digits, while going 11-2 overall. Plus they're 11-0 in the last 11 games that Deron Williams has played.

rankings.summaryHtml: Interesting stretch to register in your datebook: East's best will play Suns, Mavs, Spurs and Rockets from March 16-23, with only one of those games (Dallas) at home.

rankings.summaryHtml: Proud as they are to be 20-12 without Yao, Rockets have lost five of their last eight games. In other words, they'll be relieved to see him back in the lineup Monday.

rankings.summaryHtml: February was the best month in team history: 9-3 for a .750 winning percentage. But Raps looked like they read their press clippings all weekend, starting March at 0-2.

rankings.summaryHtml: Hornets were 29-23 last season before sliding into the lottery with a 9-21 nosedive. This season? Hoping for the opposite, Hornets are 16-10 since cratering to 12-22.

rankings.summaryHtml: Word of advice, Nuggets. Savor the next seven games, five at home, because no one in the league faces a harder finish: 13 of the final 18 games on the road.
